@@U02508@@
And every step you take, these halls will follow, for they are alive, their very walls teem with life, darting every which way. Monsters of the sea will throng and surge toward the strange, soft glow, but none will be allowed to enter. Dragons will sport in your sight, richly colored, with scales of gold, and sharks show you their lethal jaws, and you will laugh in their teeth. However much your court here may delight you, you will never have witnessed such grand company. Nor will you be long parted from what is loveliest. 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女 will come, curious to see the splendid new dwelling in the sea’s eternal freshness. The young will be like fishes, timid but no less wanton; the older ones rather more prudent. 忒提斯 will hear the news and come, proffering her hand and lips to the new 普罗透斯. And next there’s the seat on the heights of 奥林匹斯山—

@@U02510@@
Thank you, but no. We ascend that throne soon enough.

@@U02512@@
And as for the earth, Majesty, you already own that.

@@U02514@@
What stroke of luck brought you here straight out of the Arabian Nights? Be as resourceful as Scheherazade and I assure you the highest of favors.
translation:
@@U02508@@
你迈出的每一步，这些大厅都会跟随，因为它们是有生命的，它们的墙壁充满生机，向四面八方飞奔。海中的怪物会蜂拥而至，涌向那奇异而柔和的光芒，但没有一个被允许进入。龙将在你的视野中嬉戏，它们色彩丰富，有着金色的鳞片，鲨鱼向你展示它们致命的下巴，你会从它们的牙齿中笑出来。无论这里的宫廷让您多么高兴，您都永远不会亲眼目睹如此盛大的公司。你也不会与最可爱的东西分开太久。 涅瑞伊得斯海仙女会来，好奇地想看看大海里永远新鲜的华丽新居所。年轻人将像鱼一样，胆怯，但同样肆意；年长的人比较谨慎。 忒提斯听到这个消息就会赶来，向新普罗透斯伸出她的手和嘴唇。接下来是奥林匹斯山高处的座位——

@@U02510@@
谢谢你，但是不行。我们很快就会登上那个王位。

@@U02512@@
至于地球，陛下，您已经拥有了它。

@@U02514@@
是什么运气让你从天方夜谭中直接来到这里？像山鲁佐德一样足智多谋，我向你保证最崇高的恩惠。
